scope: Independent finite Python sanity and deliberately false controls; not a Lean proof or whole-paper test.

controls.name: supported edge into MRCA is removed
controls.meaning: Kills the false equality between support filtering and truncation.

controls.name: unique MRCA of the worked graph
controls.meaning: Finite independent instance of the explanatory diagram.

controls.name: MRCA-to-sample paths survive
controls.meaning: Survival is checked from the MRCA, not from older removed ancestors.

controls.name: older-ancestor paths do not survive
controls.meaning: Kills the false claim of all original ancestry preservation.

controls.name: singleton sample leaves no edges
controls.meaning: Reflexive sample ancestry makes the singleton already coalesced.

controls.name: empty samples leave no edges
controls.meaning: Support filtering prevents vacuous common ancestry from retaining edges.

controls.name: ancestral sample stays protected
controls.meaning: The ancestral sample can have one child; an all-vertices arity claim is false.

controls.name: without unique parents MRCA existence can fail
controls.meaning: Two incomparable common ancestors defeat an unconditional existence claim.

controls.name: sampled-root forest has no MRCA
controls.meaning: Common-ancestor existence is a real premise.

controls.name: sample traces miss an unsupported branch
controls.meaning: Kills the unconditional Appendix E sample-array inverse.

controls.name: touching pieces merge and real gap remains
controls.meaning: Matches the separately kernel-checked Lean example.

controls.name: gap-filling changes semantics
controls.meaning: Kills the false claim that arbitrary gaps may be filled.

controls.name: overlap violates ordered-input separation claim
controls.meaning: The ordered nonoverlap premise cannot be removed.

controls.name: unsorted input need not normalize
controls.meaning: The list merge is not a sorting algorithm.

controls.name: empty interval is outside proper-interval type
controls.meaning: Zero-span annotations are not values of Interval; empty region sets are allowed separately.
